content.snl: variable(__list__(Type.annotation(@$\mathbb{K}$,Type),Type.annotation(@V,Type),LA.Field($\mathbb{K}$),LA.VectorSpace(V,$\mathbb{K}$),Type.annotation(@W,$\mathrm{Submodule}\ \mathbb{K}\ V$),Type.annotation(@hIP,InnerProductSpace($\mathbb{K}$,V)),Type.annotation(@hproj,$W.\mathrm{HasOrthogonalProjection}$)),def(Submodule.orthogonalProjection(W),,$\pi_W x \in W,\quad x - \pi_W x \in W^{\perp};\quad \text{such a } w \in W \text{ is unique (and minimises } \|x-w\|)$))

values.zh-CN: 对具有正交投影的子空间 $W$（需实例 `W.HasOrthogonalProjection`），`Submodule.orthogonalProjection W : V →L[𝕜] W` 是满足 $\pi_W x\in W$ 与 $x-\pi_W x\in W^\perp$ 的连续线性映射；满足这两条且落在 $W$ 中的元素唯一，并且 $x-\pi_W x\in W^\perp$、$\pi_W x$ 是 $W$ 中离 $x$ 最近的点。显式参数只有子空间 $W$。
values.en: For a subspace $W$ with an orthogonal projection (instance `W.HasOrthogonalProjection`), `Submodule.orthogonalProjection W : V →L[𝕜] W` is the continuous linear map with $\pi_W x\in W$ and $x-\pi_W x\in W^\perp$; the element of $W$ satisfying these two conditions is unique, and $\pi_W x$ is the closest point of $W$ to $x$. The only explicit argument is the subspace $W$.
